title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU Support for Participation in EU Programmes and Agencies for 2024 TR2024AAP

description.narrative: Participation in EU programmes and agencies is an important Action covered under Window 2: Good governance, European Union (EU) acquis alignment, good neighbourly relations and strategic communication of the IPA III Programming Framework. Through its participation in the EU programmes and agencies, Türkiye has the opportunity to: (i) build knowledge and capacities of the different stakeholders dealing with European issues; (ii) actively participate in the implementation of EU policies; and (iii) intensify international cooperation and mobility in relation to EU countries, thus becoming more deeply involved in the EU integration process. Participation in EU programmes and agencies encourages the active involvement of public and private institutions, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), NGOs, civil society organisations, universities, research institutes, techno parks and individuals to benefit from and contribute to the EU accession process.For 2021-2027 period, Türkiye continues to participate in the following EU programmes and agencies: Horizon Europe, Erasmus+, European Solidarity Corps (ESC), Union Civil Protection Mechanism (UCPM), Customs, Digital Europe Programme, Single Market Programme, European Environment Agency (EEA) and the European Union Drugs Agency (EUDA). Total financial contribution for participation in the programmes, the so-called, ¿entry tickets¿ is expected to increase incrementally in line with the increase in the annual budget of work programmes in the upcoming years.In this regard, this Action Document (AD) lays out the need for EU support for Türkiye¿s participation in the EU programmes and agencies in the form of ¿co-financing of the entry tickets¿ to be paid by Türkiye in the year 2024.
